##### Project general facts

Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad, is a limited collection of five-bedroom villas developed by DarGlobal, with interiors designed in collaboration with the House of Mouawad, the long-established luxury jewellery house. The villas are offered across nine layout types, each built around monolithic architectural forms, varying parapet heights, and elegant window boxes that draw on ancestral textures and colors. The design reflects a celestial-inspired aesthetic intended to evoke the brilliance and craftsmanship of fine jewelry.

Residents have access to a range of community amenities, including schools, a community centre, a sports hub, restaurants and cafés, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery outlets, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics. Landscaped streets, walking paths and green open spaces connect the villas with these facilities, creating a calm, family-oriented setting where everyday needs, leisure and social life are always close to home.

Interiors are finished with porcelain floor tiles, refined wall coverings, and a palette of opulent creams across the majlis and family living areas. Each villa includes a master bedroom with a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom, additional bedrooms finished to the same standard, and an enclosed private terrace. The villas are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Riyadh is the dynamic capital of Saudi Arabia and one of the fastest-growing cities in the region, known for its powerful blend of tradition and modernity. As the political, financial, and administrative center of the Kingdom, it offers a highly developed urban environment with a strong economy and continuous large-scale development driven by the national transformation programme. The city is defined by its modern skyline, wide road networks, and rapidly expanding infrastructure.

The lifestyle in Riyadh is shaped by a wide range of world-class amenities, including luxury shopping malls, fine dining, cultural landmarks, and entertainment destinations. Areas such as King Abdullah Financial District and Boulevard Riyadh City highlight the city’s transformation into a vibrant global hub. Parks, recreational spaces, and modern lifestyle developments further enhance the quality of living, creating a balanced environment for both residents and visitors.

Riyadh also benefits from excellent connectivity, anchored by King Khalid International Airport and a growing public transport network, including the Riyadh Metro. Its strategic location and continued investment in infrastructure make it a prime destination for business, living, and real estate investment, offering long-term growth potential in one of the region’s most important cities.
